topic: sub:12|Trigonometry|Area of a triangle, A = ½ab sin C

figures.cap: triangle XYZ with XY = 10 m, XZ = 9 m

solutions.latex:
Using the area formula $A = \dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$:
$$\begin{aligned} 43 &= \dfrac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 9 \times \sin C \\ \sin C &= \dfrac{2 \times 43}{90} \\ C &= \sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{43 \times 2}{10 \times 9}\right) \\ &\approx 73^\circ \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Substitutes correctly into the area formula, or equivalent merit

figures.cap: triangle with sides 30 cm, 28 cm, x cm and included angle 44 degrees

parts.latex:
The area of the triangle shown is $250\ \text{cm}^2$.

NOT TO SCALE

\exfigure{2839_q1a_1}

What is the value of $x$, correct to the nearest whole number?

solutions.latex:
Using the area formula for a triangle, $A=\dfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$:
$$\begin{aligned}250 &= \dfrac{1}{2}\times 30\times x\times \sin 44^\circ \\ x &= \dfrac{250}{15\sin 44^\circ} \\ &= 23.99\ldots\end{aligned}$$
To the nearest whole number $x=24$, which is option D.
